name: LaunchBoard

sources.title: LaunchBoard homepage — weekly launch competition, live board
How LaunchBoard Works — 3-step process, weekly cycle, winner rules
Pricing — Free (badge), Single Launch $19, Launch Pack $39/5 credits

conditions: Free listing requires embedding the LaunchBoard badge on your site
Free tier gets homepage placement for launch week but a dofollow backlink only if the product wins the weekly #1
No AI blog generation on the free plan; launch is queued into the weekly batch (max 25/week) after a quality review
requirements: Indie maker / SaaS product with a working website
Products launch in weekly batches every Monday at 03:30 UTC
preparation: Product name, description, category, tags, website URL, and maker info
LaunchBoard badge placed on your site (free route)
Optional: $19 Single Launch (instant approval, permanent DR50+ dofollow, 1 AI blog post ~1,500 words) or $39 Launch Pack (5 credits, never expire)
workflow: Submit the product with name/description/category/tags/site/maker info and choose free or paid
Get queued into the next weekly batch (max 25 products/week); quality review happens before launch
Launch Monday 03:30 UTC on the homepage leaderboard
Winner = upvotes + comments; ties break on upvotes then earliest launch time
watchFor: Free-plan dofollow only materialises if you win the week — otherwise the badge is a one-way link
No refunds after submission; unused Launch Pack credits stay in the account
Paid plans are one-time payments (no subscription)
Site is unusually agent-friendly: llms.txt, llms-full.txt, /api/ai JSON snapshot, and Accept: text/markdown or .md on any URL
countsAsLive: Product page at /launch/<slug> live and listed in the current week's 'Top product launches' board with upvote count
unknowns: Whether an account is required to submit (submission flow not detailed on public pages)
Exact badge markup and verification method
How far ahead the free queue is booked
